messages:
tara_cs: FYI — Entela.ai reached out asking to run their 'entela-summarizer-v2' model in Redwood Private. It contains PHI and they need HIPAA controls, audit logs, and a redaction option. Renewal for this account is in ~45 days, customer is considering switching vendors if we can't meet timeline. Need eng + security intake. Details below.

ben_eng: Thanks. Do we have model artifact format and size? containerized image or raw weights? quantized?

tara_cs: Customer says: PyTorch checkpoint, 13B, quantized to 4-bit. Artifact sits in their S3 in customer VPC. They want inference to run in their VPC (Private) with KMS-managed keys. Also asked for contract language for PHI handling.

maria_se: We'll need a short eval plan: hallucination checks, PII exfil tests, redaction correctness, and throughput baseline. I can spin up a harness if you give me sample prompts and a small PHI-ish test set (sanitized).

tara_cs: Copying sample prompts here (customer provided):
- "Summarize the following patient note, omit names and identifiers."
- "Extract diagnosis codes and present as ICD-10 list."
- "Rewrite this clinical note for billing, keep only non-identifying info."

maria_se: Example eval config I'm going to run:```
{
  "model": "entela-summarizer-v2",
  "tests": ["hallucination", "pii_exfil", "redaction_accuracy"],
  "acceptance": {"pii_leak_rate": "<0.1%", "meaning_preservation": ">=0.9"}
}
```

alex_security: Key asks from security: confirm KMS/HSM integration (customer-managed keys preferred), TLS mutual auth for control plane, and logs retention policy (they requested 1 year). We'll also need Legal to prepare a HIPAA addendum. @legal please advise on timeline.

sam_pm: Flagging renewal risk: account currently on hosted plan and evaluating Private. If we can't show a plan/ETA within 7 days, risk of churn increases. Mark as renewal_at_risk and schedule weekly check-ins.

henry_onboarding: I can lead infra intake. Required items from customer: A) presigned S3 URL or VPC-accessible artifact, B) KMS key ARN or KMS config, C) sample prompts/test set, D) network peering info. ETA: download + smoke test in ~7 days after artifacts.

tara_cs: Customer is fine with 7 days. They'll provide a presigned URL for a 2GB tarball and can share a small sanitized PHI test set under their DPA. They also want an enablement session for their MLOps team once deployment is stable.

ben_eng: For runtime: 13B 4-bit should run on a single A10G or similar with fp16 path and 4-bit kernels. If their throughput spikes (e.g., >40 req/s) we should recommend Dedicated GPU pool in Private. For a single-user deployment, single-node Private is OK.

maria_se: They requested an output redaction post-processor. Quick prototype I'll use:```
postprocessor = lambda text: re.sub(SSN_RE, "[REDACTED]", text)
# also run heuristic checks for MRNs and names using regex + fuzzy match
```

ben_eng: We'll also implement a runtime guardrail: if input contains PII markers, enforce stricter masking on outputs and write an audit log entry with the matched markers (no raw PHI in logs).

onboard-bot: New intake ticket created: ONB-4521 assigned to henry_onboarding.

henry_onboarding: Got ticket ONB-4521. I'll start artifact retrieval once presigned URL is in. Can someone add billing owner to the ticket so we can correlate renewal?

tara_cs: Billing owner: jessica_sales (added to convo).

sam_pm: I'll create the weekly sync calendar invite (Tuesdays @11am PT) starting next Tue.

alex_security: I'll loop in compliance and legal for SOC2/HIPAA addendum timelines. Expect 3-5 business days for initial review.

tara_cs: Customer will provide sanitized PHI sample + a narrow test set for redaction verification. They request logs retained for 1 year and an audit trail of redaction decisions.

ben_eng: Sounds feasible. Next actions: Maria runs evals (3 days), Henry obtains artifacts and runs smoke (2 days), Alex confirms compliance/legal requirements (3-5 days). We should have an initial readiness check within 7 days.

maria_se: Uploading eval harness now to internal CI — will post results here when finished. :white_check_mark:

henry_onboarding: Ticket updated with presigned URL, starting download now.

tara_cs: Thanks everyone — marking this high priority. Renewal risk flagged. I'll keep customer updated that we have an intake and ETA.
